meta.description: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器网页，完成抓取、测试和截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要频繁操作浏览器完成重复性任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browser interactions for scraping, testing, and screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能像你一样操作浏览器：打开网页、点击按钮、输入文字、截图、抓取数据。它还可以录制操作过程并生成视频。
howto.when: 当你需要与网页交互（如登录、填表、点击）、获取需要JavaScript渲染的内容、或处理反爬页面时触发。如果简单HTTP请求就能获取数据，就不要用。

say.note: Claude 会打开新标签页，加载网页并截图。

say.text: 帮我登录邮箱，查看最近一封邮件。
say.note: Claude 会引导你登录后操作浏览器查看邮件。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to control a browser directly for tasks like clicking, typing, navigating, scraping, screenshotting, and recording. It uses CDP to connect to local or cloud Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when web interaction is needed (login, form fill, clicks), JS rendering is required, or bot-protected pages are encountered. Do not use if a plain HTTP request suffices.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens a new tab, loads the page, and captures a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log into my email and show me the latest message.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through login and then retrieves the email via browser.
